name: Kling 4.0 AI Video Generator
tagline: Kling 4.0 | Cinematic AI Videos Up to 30s with More Control
description:
Kling 4.0 is an AI video generation model designed to turn text prompts, images, and reference materials into cinematic videos. It provides tools for creating longer scenes, controlling key moments, maintaining character and product consistency, and combining visual content with synchronized audio.

The platform allows users to generate videos from 3 to 30 seconds, with 720p and 1080p output options. It also provides different creative modes for text-to-video, keyframe-based generation, and multimodal reference creation.

How does Kling 4.0 work?
Users can start with a written prompt, upload reference images or videos, and describe the subjects, actions, camera movements, and visual style they want.

Main features include:
Text-to-Video — generate videos directly from written descriptions.
Keyframe Control — use up to 10 keyframe images to guide important moments in a video.
Omni Reference — combine images, videos, and voice references to guide video generation.
Image-to-Video — animate still images with AI-generated movement.
3–30 Second Videos — create longer sequences with more complete storytelling.
720p & 1080p Output — choose the resolution based on your project.
Video Editing — make targeted changes to existing footage, including expressions, backgrounds, and camera movements.
Camera & Motion Control — guide tracking shots, camera movements, and continuous actions.
Stereo Audio & Lip Sync — generate synchronized sound and dialogue with improved audio-visual alignment.

Who uses Kling 4.0?
Kling 4.0 is suitable for content creators, filmmakers, marketers, designers, e-commerce businesses, and creative agencies.

Content creators can use it for social media videos and visual storytelling. Marketing teams can develop product advertisements and promotional clips, while filmmakers can use keyframes and reference materials to explore characters, scenes, and camera movements.

Overall, Kling 4.0 combines text-to-video generation, keyframe control, multimodal references, video editing, and synchronized audio in one online AI video creation workflow.
